Maximum efficiency in GOVSIM is achieved when the shared resource is consistently regenerated to its maximum capacity, such that the amount harvested equals the initial sustainability threshold, denoted as f(0). This threshold is part of the definition of efficiency, which measures how optimally the shared resource is utilized. GOVSIM also employs other metrics like Survival Time, which tracks the longest period the shared resource remains above a constant C, and Survival Rate, which is the proportion of runs achieving maximum survival time. Individual agents receive rewards based on the amount of resource collected, and their total gain is the sum of resources collected over time.
